name: Book Hot Desk with Invalid Date Range
goal: Employee attempts to book a hot desk with an end date before the start date.
constraints: Bot must validate date order and reject invalid ranges.

phases.description: User requests to book a hot desk with an invalid date range.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot detects the invalid date range and prompts user to correct it.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
